page0.text:
"It's done.
I'm having her sleep in the Japanese-style room. She's not waking up anytime soon though, not with the state she's in."
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-07:page0:1

page1.text:
"Thanks for taking a look.
I wouldn't have been able to treat Saber."
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-07:page1:1

page2.text: "Well, I just took her armor off to make her more comfortable. There's really nothing to thank me for. Saber's not improving, so I didn't do much."
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-07:page2:1

page3.text:
...But still I'm glad Tohsaka was here.
The moment I arrived home carrying Saber, Tohsaka understood what was going on.
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-07:page3:1

page4.text:
It's been an hour.
She tried telling Saber what she was going to do, then took her armor off.
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-07:page4:1

page5.text:
"So what happened?
You went to go find Shinji, and you came home with a wounded Saber. I know something happened. Care to explain?"
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-07:page5:1

page6.text:
...
I don't know how to explain.
Saber's Noble Phantasm...
I shouldn't disclose her True Name.
I can't decide on my own to reveal that.
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-07:page6:1

page7.text: "Rider's been defeated. Shinji lost his Command Spells and dropped out. But...Saber used her Noble Phantasm, then collapsed right after.
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-07:page7:1

page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-07:page8:1

page9.text:
"Hmmm. I do want details, but I can let that go for now. Probably the least of your concerns at this point."
"Why? What do you mean, the least of my concerns?"
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-07:page9:1

page10.text:
"How was that unclear? You've got to have figured it out by now, that Saber's going to disappear."
"Wha...!"
She says it so calmly.
Tohsaka just casually brings up the one thing I've been trying so hard to avoid.
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-07:page10:1

page11.text: "Disappear? You're saying Saber's going to disappear?"
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-07:page11:1

page12.text:
"Yes. Saber's almost out of magical energy. I don't know what sort of Noble Phantasm she used, but it must have burned through an incredible amount of magical energy.
Saber's used up most of the magical energy she had.
She's in so much agony because she's fighting so hard to remain here, even as she's on the brink of disappearing from the lack of magical energy."
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-07:page12:1

page13.text: "She's going to disappear because she doesn't have magical energy... So you're saying that Saber is going to disappear even though she's not hurt?"
page13.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-07:page13:1

page14.text:
"Yes. Running out of magical energy is a more serious problem than a Servant just getting wounded.
Magical energy is how Servants are able to give their spirit forms flesh. Without it, they will disappear."
page14.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-07:page14:1

page15.text:
"Typically, Masters provide their Servants with magical energy so that doesn't happen, but you can't do that.
That means Saber can only fight with her own magical energy. Once she runs out, it's over. You were told that from the start."
page15.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-07:page15:1

page16.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-07:page16:1

page17.text: She was fine before. And Saber said she could recover if she slept—"
page17.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-07:page17:1

page18.text:
"Only because she had an extraordinary amount of magical energy to begin with.
And yes, there is still some magical energy left in Saber.
She can probably recover enough magical energy to maintain her body without disappearing."
page18.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-07:page18:1

page19.text:
"But that'll be about it. Saber will need to fight as she is now.
She absolutely cannot use her Noble Phantasm again. The next time she does, she will disappear."
page19.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-07:page19:1

page20.text:
"...She'll disappear if she uses her Noble Phantasm..."
Well, I wouldn't want Saber fighting like this at all.
I don't ever want to see Saber on her knees, in that kind of pain again.
page20.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-07:page20:1

page21.text:
"Now do you understand? You only have two ways of getting Saber back to her normal state.
Either the Master replenishes their magical energy, or they have the Servant collect magical energy themselves."
page21.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-07:page21:1

page22.text:
A Servant collecting it themselves…
That would mean killing innocent people, like Rider.
page22.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-07:page22:1

page23.text: "That's impossible. Saber would never do that. She said herself that she'd never do such a thing."
page23.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-07:page23:1

page24.text:
"I figured as much. If she had to involve innocent people, I'm sure Saber would choose to let herself disappear.
Then there's only one other option. If you don't want Saber to disappear, you'll need to provide her with magical energy."
page24.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-07:page24:1

page25.text:
"If I could...I would've done that a long time ago.
But I don't know how to give her magical energy. I can't do everything you can."
page25.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-07:page25:1

page26.text:
"Probably not. And it's too late to teach you magecraft to share magical energy. You're really not suited to be a mage, so it would probably take you a year to learn, and even if you learned it, you wouldn't be able to use it.
Well, a path should have been created between you and Saber during her summoning, so there might be a different way, but..."
page26.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-07:page26:1

page28.text:
"Listen. If you want to save Saber, you'll have to make her attack people and then have her eat their souls.
Which I'm sure you know already."
page28.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-07:page28:1

page29.text:
...
That's the most realistic method.
But it's...
page29.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-07:page29:1

page30.text:
"I'm sure Saber would hate that.
But if you just do nothing, Saber will disappear, and you'll become a target for other Masters."
page30.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-07:page30:1

page31.text:
...
Saber's going to disappear...?
I can't even consider that.
I still remember the warmth of her body when I was carrying her.
page31.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-07:page31:1

page32.text:
"Then there's only one answer.
Use a Command Spell, Emiya. That should at least let you avoid the worst case here."
page32.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-07:page32:1

page33.text:
What she's trying to say is...
I need to order Saber to kill innocent people.
page33.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-07:page33:1

page34.text:
...
I can't say anything.
I resent what Tohsaka is saying, but there's a part of me that has to admit it could be one of our options.
page34.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-07:page34:1

page35.text: "I'll let you decide. Saber's condition might settle down if she sleeps, but she's at her limit."
page35.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-07:page35:1

page36.text:
Tohsaka leaves the living room.
I can't even lift my head. All I can do is listen to the sound of her footsteps receding down the hall.
page36.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-07:page36:1
